title: Power of the Podrace
description: Jedi ambassadors Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi try to convince Gungan Boss Nass, leader of Naboo's underwater realm, to help desperate Queen Amidala fight the invading Trade Federation that threatens their mutual security. Instead of a pledge of support, the Jedi are given clumsy outcast native Jar Jar Binks as an ally. They all speed away on the Queens starship heading for Coruscant and the sympathetic Galactic Senate, with Amidala pretending to be her own handmaiden, Padmé. Stopping for repairs on Tatooine, the adventurers soon encounter a most unusual little boy named Anakin Skywalker. Qui-Gon soon suspects that Skywalker may be a "vergence in the Force" destined to bring balance to the galaxy, according to an ancient prophecy...
